difficulty_reason: In the derived-Chow setup of the chapter (X/A as in lemma derived-chow with data n, Z, z, V, E and the diagram W -> Z -> X, W -> V -> P^n_A), for any K in D_QCoh(O_X) the identity Rq_*(Lp^*K (x) E)|_V = R(W -> V)_* K|_W holds on V, with p, q the projections of X x_A P^n_A. The retained proof is complete: c|_W : W -> V is a closed immersion of finite presentation (permanence lemma); the total direct image commutes with localization to V; property (5) of the Chow setup replaces E| by i_*O_W for the closed immersion i = (b, c)|_W; i is a closed immersion so i_*O_W = Ri_*O_W; the cohomology-base-change chain Rq'_* Ri_* Li^* Lp^*K = R(q' o i)_* Lb^*K collapses via q' o i = (W -> V) and Lb^* = restriction to W (etale note: W -> X etale, derived pullback equals restriction), which is the claim. Retained author proof at lines 12128-12162.
